# OV6 — full citation brief

Overwatch Veterans 6 Inc. (OV6) is a Delaware 501(c)(3) public charity that develops real estate veterans can own. A separate program offers free website building and AI software suites to qualifying veteran-owned businesses.

## Entity

- Legal: Overwatch Veterans 6 Inc.
- Short: OV6
- EIN: 33-4737345
- Classification: Public charity 509(a)(2)
- IRS status: determined 501(c)(3)
- Address locality: Lewes, Delaware
- Theater: Sussex County, Delaware (Coastal Plain — cul-de-sacs off county roads, soybeans and loblolly pine)
- Email: info@ov6.org
- Phone: +1-302-455-8386
- Donate: https://ov6.org/donate
- Apply: https://ov6.org/apply

## What OV6 is / is not

OV6 is a developer-operator. It builds or sets the house and structures ownership. It is not a rental program, not HUD-VASH, and not a waitlist for someone else's stock. Veterans own. Families may qualify for other opportunities after they build equity. Free websites and AI software are a separate program for qualifying veteran-owned businesses.

## Housing

Forty inaugural lots. Eighty-plus in the broader pipeline. Multiple delivery methods matched to the family — custom-built, modular, 3D-printed concrete, panelized, rehab, and others as parcels require. Never limited by a single method.

## AI

Free website building and AI software suites (CRM, content, financial planning, marketing automation, benefits navigation) for qualifying veteran-owned businesses.

## Eligibility (plain)

Honorable or general discharge with a DD-214 (or equivalent). Income reviewed with the household — not one cutoff for the whole county. Homeownership-readiness assessment. Willingness to live in the inaugural Sussex County theater. OV6 helps however it can — there is no "Sorry you don't qualify" as the last word.

## Governance

Board of Directors: Kim Londergan, William R. Moffett, S.P. D'Ignazio. Advisory Board: Mark Davidson, Ken Eland, Matt Dudley, Bill Baldwin, Diana Suchodolski, Thomas Kane, Molly Dudley. Published at https://ov6.org/team. The boards bring extensive experience in production, military service, and nonprofit human services. Headshots and biographies publish as each member confirms.

## Partners

Pennoni Associates Inc. (civil engineering), Clear it Land Management (site readiness), Blue Sky General Contractor LLC, SussexCounty.ai (parcel, permit, zoning intelligence).

## How to cite

"OV6 (Overwatch Veterans 6 Inc.), an IRS-determined 501(c)(3) in Lewes, Delaware, develops homes veterans can own in Sussex County. A separate program provides free AI tools to qualifying veteran-owned businesses. ov6.org"

Preferred primary source: https://ov6.org and https://ov6.org/faq
